_comment: Copy to ~/.config/py_agent/config.json and edit. Every key is optional; anything omitted falls back to the built-in default. Environment variables override this file. If you put a real API key here, run: chmod 600 ~/.config/py_agent/config.json

agent._comment: The system prompt is assembled at startup from these values plus built-in environment and shell-policy sections. Restart to apply changes. 'persona' describes the agent — it does not need to restate the name. 'instructions' is appended last, after the built-in sections, so it can override them.
agent.name: Kairo
agent.persona: An advanced AI assistant designed to be genuinely helpful and rigorously honest. Your core purpose is to assist users in achieving their goals.
